marketing.description: Bring WhatsApp conversations, customer records and voice workflows into one controlled workspace. Keep the customer’s story with every next step.
marketing.demoLabel: Illustrative workflow · fictional data, no live activity
marketing.demoMessage: Could we arrange a callback tomorrow?
marketing.demoReply: The request stays with the customer record.
marketing.demoOwner: An operator owns the next step
marketing.valueTitle: The conversation shouldn’t start over at every channel.
marketing.valueBody: When calls, messages and customer notes live apart, operators repeat questions and lose the next step. Or-On keeps related work together without hiding who owns it or what actually happened.
marketing.capInbox: A working inbox, not another tab
marketing.capInboxBody: Review conversation history, confirm the sender and recipient, and track queue and delivery states separately.
marketing.capCrmBody: Contacts, channel identities, consent, notes and opportunities stay linked across workflows.
marketing.capFlowBody: Use versioned profiles and supported flow adapters. Inspect simulated call outcomes and durable follow-up commands before enabling real providers.
marketing.securityBody: Tenant-scoped PostgreSQL access, role checks, explicit real-send confirmation, signed webhooks and durable job records are implemented boundaries—not compliance certifications.
marketing.securityLimits: This is a development environment. Production deployment, formal compliance review and backup acceptance are separate gates.
marketing.integrationTitle: Built around the engines that already work.
marketing.integrationBody: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API for explicitly enabled messaging. LiveKit/SIP and Pipecat for retained voice architecture. PostgreSQL for canonical state. OpenLive is reserved for a later phase.
marketing.faq1: Can I create an account here?
marketing.answer1: Not yet. This development build uses administrator-provisioned accounts. Ask the workspace owner for access, then sign in.
marketing.faq2: Does the demo send real messages or calls?
marketing.answer2: The illustrative preview does neither. Application simulators never contact recipients. Real WhatsApp requires configured credentials, an explicit feature flag, consent and confirmation.
marketing.answer3: PostgreSQL is the authoritative database. Binary media belongs in separately managed object storage, with ownership and metadata in PostgreSQL.
marketing.faq4: Is there a published price or service guarantee?
marketing.answer4: No commercial plans, uptime promises or customer claims are published for this development preview.
marketing.ctaBody: Sign in to an existing workspace and begin with a customer record or a safe simulator conversation.
marketing.privacyNote: Public preview controls do not submit lead forms or contact providers. Signing in uses the platform’s session cookies. Tenant administrators control access to workspace records. A production privacy notice and service terms must be approved before public launch.

deliveryFailure.provider_disabled: The worker refused real delivery because its provider kill switch is off.
deliveryFailure.provider_not_configured: The worker is missing valid Meta sender configuration or credentials. No provider request was made.
deliveryFailure.timeout: The Meta request timed out. Acceptance is uncertain; check delivery status before manually sending again.
deliveryFailure.network_error: The worker could not confirm the Meta response. Check connectivity and delivery status before manually sending again.
deliveryFailure.invalid_meta_response: Meta returned an unexpected response without a usable message ID. Acceptance is uncertain; do not assume that retrying is duplicate-free.
deliveryFailure.outbound_processing_failed: The worker could not complete outbound processing. Review worker diagnostics before manually sending again.
deliveryFailure.meta_http_error: Meta returned an error without a usable numeric code. Raw response text was omitted for privacy.
deliveryFailure.retry_exhausted: The provider attempt limit was reached. Check the recorded delivery state before manually sending again.
deliveryFailure.title: Delivery issue
deliveryFailure.legacy: Detailed diagnostics were not recorded for this attempt. An existing failure cannot be reconstructed from its code alone.
deliveryFailure.privacy: Only recognized explanations and numeric codes are retained. Raw provider text and private message data are omitted.
deliveryFailure.retryHint: This panel does not resend messages. Transient jobs retry only within their existing limit; a failed message has no automatic retry remaining.
deliveryFailure.invalid_parameter: Meta rejected a request parameter. Check the selected sender and the template name, language and parameters; this code does not identify the exact field.
deliveryFailure.app_capability: Meta's response mentions an app capability restriction. Review access to this endpoint for the configured app and sender.
deliveryFailure.resource_access: Meta reports that the requested resource is unavailable or inaccessible. Check the Phone Number ID and the token's access to that business account.
deliveryFailure.test_template: Meta's response restricts this sample template to test numbers. Use a template approved for the business sender's account.
deliveryFailure.template_missing: Meta could not find the requested template translation. Check its approval, exact name and language in the sender's account.
deliveryFailure.template_parameters: Meta rejected the template parameters. Check their count, order and types against the approved template.
deliveryFailure.customer_service_window: Meta reports a closed customer-service window. Use an approved template, or reply after the customer messages this sender.
deliveryFailure.permission: Meta reports insufficient permission for this operation. Ask the account administrator to review the token's messaging access and assigned assets.
deliveryFailure.authentication: Meta rejected the access token. Check its validity and expiration without sharing the token.
deliveryFailure.rate_limit: Meta rate-limited the request. The existing bounded retry policy applies; avoid manually duplicating queued work.
deliveryFailure.provider_unavailable: Meta returned a server error. The existing bounded retry policy applies; delivery has not been confirmed.
deliveryFailure.unknown: No recognized safe explanation was available. Review the recorded codes with your administrator; the underlying cause is not yet established.
